sm_top.sm: Ukrainian naval drones attacked two vessels off Benghazi, prompting a UN investigation.
Iran conducted missile and drone attacks on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain, causing two injuries and debris damage.
Poland accused Russia of a drone incursion into its airspace, prompting NATO AWACS deployment.
Finland reports that Russia has begun towing a cargo ship that was previously struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
The death toll rises after a Russian strike hits an apartment building near Kyiv.
Malaysia announced it respects the ICJ ruling regarding Myanmar and pledged commitment to international law in addressing the Rohingya crisis.
IDF airstrike eliminated Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal in Gaza.
UKMTO reported an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman.
President Bukele confirmed details regarding the deaths of three Salvadoran soldiers during military operations in Haiti.
Three oil tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the IRGC.
A Russian drone strike on an apartment building in Dymer near Kyiv killed 11 people.
A Russian merchant vessel damaged by drones in the Gulf of Finland returned to St Petersburg.
Saudi strikes on buses and trucks in Yemen caused about 25–26 casualties.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed a senior Hamas security official.
A Russian attack in Zaporizhzhia killed at least two people.
NATO deploys AWACS aircraft to Poland amid Russian airspace violations.
Airstrikes hit Hodeidah, Yemen, killing 17 civilians at telecommunications infrastructure.
Houthis claimed a direct hit on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery.
Russia launched over 150 drones at Ukraine overnight, with a majority intercepted by air defenses.
35 people were killed in revenge attacks in Nigeria.
Russian forces attacked Ukraine with jet-powered drones, and air defense forces shot down 73 UAVs.
Russian air defenses shot down 10 Ukrainian drones headed for Moscow, according to the mayor.
Fresh violence in South Sudan resulted in the deaths of 24 civilians.
The Russian Ministry of Defense claims its air defenses destroyed 699 Ukrainian drones overnight.
At least 64 people were killed in weekend attacks in Niger State, Nigeria.
Russian forces conducted a missile or drone strike on Kyiv, leaving civilians trapped under rubble.
Multiple merchant vessels were struck in the Black Sea, resulting in the sinking of two vessels and injuries to seafarers.
Russian strikes on energy infrastructure leave Odesa oblast without electricity, heating, and water.
Reports indicate Iran has attacked 64 ships in eight weeks as multiple vessels are hit in the same incident.
Ukrainian naval drones sank a Russian warship off Benghazi, Libya.
Russian forces launched over 90 drones in an overnight attack against Ukraine.
Over 60 people were killed in attacks in Nigeria.
Iran launched missile and drone attacks against US bases and civilian sites in the Gulf region.
Russian strikes on energy facilities in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast caused fires and left over 350,000 homes without power.
Russian strikes in the Kyiv region killed at least 14 people.
A Houthi missile strike damaged Riyadh's tallest tower, housing the Saudi wealth fund.
Armed attack killed 15 civilians in Warrap State, South Sudan
Somalia defence minister said forces killed nearly 285 Al-Shabaab members
An armed cattle raid in Tonj East County left 87 people dead and 60 others injured.
A 7-year-old boy was rescued after being trapped for 14 hours in rubble following a Russian drone attack.
